name: DES J0227-4718 (Hubble)
blurb: DES J0227-4718, a strong gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: desj02274718-hubble
story: Light from a galaxy far in the background is bent around a foreground galaxy on its way to us, turning gravity itself into a lens.

claims.text: Hubble object DESJ0227-4718 is AGEL022709-471856A, observed in program 16773
The lens has a foreground deflector and a much more distant background source with measured redshifts
